description: The plot illustrates the Macro-F1 Score (%) as a function of the Number of tokens for two different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Number of tokens" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.5 to 1.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2 from 0.6 to 1.4. The y-axis is labeled "Macro-F1 Score (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from below 48 to above 58, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The line representing "MATTER (ours)" is depicted as a solid pink line with solid circular markers and a shaded variance band. It begins at an x-value of 0.5 with a y-value of approximately 55.1, dips slightly to 54.3 at x=0.7, and then rises to a local peak of 57.0 at x=0.8. After a slight dip to 56.3 at x=0.9, it reaches its highest peak of approximately 57.9 at x=1.0. From there, it declines to 53.0 at x=1.2 and 52.6 at x=1.3, rises slightly to 53.5 at x=1.4, and then drops sharply to end at approximately 50.9 at x=1.5. The line representing "w/o material information" is shown as a solid purple line with solid circular markers and a shaded variance band. It starts at x=0.5 with a y-value of approximately 52.5, remains relatively steady to x=0.6 (y=52.6), and rises to a peak of 54.1 at x=0.7. The line then drops to 53.3 at x=0.8, remains flat at 53.3 at x=0.9, and exhibits a gradual decline through x=1.0 (y=52.9), x=1.1 (y=52.8), x=1.2 (y=52.4), and x=1.3 (y=51.7). It then rises to 53.3 at x=1.4 before experiencing a sharp drop to end at approximately 47.9 at x=1.5.
